stages.headline: Points A and A' are symmetric about O if O is the midpoint of AA'; this is central symmetry.

stages.headline: Which of the Armenian capitals Ա, Բ, Թ, Մ, Ո have a vertical axis of symmetry (as printed)?
stages.headlineEnglish: Which of the Armenian capitals Ա, Բ, Թ, Մ, Ո have a vertical axis of symmetry (as printed)?
stages.problemText: Which of the Armenian capitals Ա, Բ, Թ, Մ, Ո have a vertical axis of symmetry (as printed)?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. Ա, Մ, Ո are left-right symmetric. 2. Բ and Թ are not.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. Ա, Մ, Ո are left-right symmetric. 2. Բ and Թ are not.
stages.customInstructions: Fonts vary; accept Ա, Մ, Ո (and Թ if the student argues it from their handwriting). Reward the reasoning.
